title: Interactive function graph
whenToUse: Use when a student needs to connect an equation with coordinates, points, and a straight-line graph.

examples.description: Show a function and let the student explore coordinates.
Hide the curve and ask the student to plot points for selected x-values.
Reveal the curve after the student completes the activity while retaining their points.
Unpin the graph, keeping its points in the notebook while subsequent content continues below.
